#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    long long limit = 10000000000LL;
    long long x = 1;
    vector<long long> powers;
    do {
        powers.push_back(x);
        x *= w;
    } while (x <= limit);

    int n = powers.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
        long long v = m;
        // add powers where bit set
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) {
                v += powers[j];
            }
        }
        // subtract powers not set, greedily from high to low
        for (int j = n - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
            if ((i & (1 << j)) == 0) {
                if (v - powers[j] >= 0) {
                    v -= powers[j];
                }
            }
        }
        if (v == 0) {
            cout << "YES" << endl;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    cout << "NO" << endl;
    return 0;
}
